name: playstation-exclusive-badge-ghost-of-yotei-until-dawn-2-nov-7
lines:
تظهر الشارة في صفحة Ghost of Yōtei
على موقع PlayStation

وتظهر في صفحة Until Dawn 2
المقبلة من سوني (Sony)

رصد مستخدم الشارة أولًا
حسب بوش سكوير (Push Square)
headline:
شارة «Exclusive» تظهر
على صفحة Ghost of Yōtei
label: تقرير

tried: PlayStation.com page videos (5 s and 10 s dark ambient loops)
YouTube (sign-in), Until Dawn 2 pre-order trailer is YouTube only

reel_check.SOURCE 1 primary read: yes: the live PlayStation.com (UAE) pages of Ghost of Yotei and Until Dawn 2 read and screenshotted 7 Nov 16:30 to 16:40Z, badge 'PlayStation Exclusive*' present on both; Push Square 15:30Z as the first report
reel_check.SOURCE 2 not already posted: yes: ledger find 'playstation exclusive badge' 0 hits; Publer 7-8 Nov list checked
reel_check.SOURCE 3 age: yes: spotted and reported 7 Nov 15:30Z, about 1 h old
reel_check.ANGLE hook: yes: Exclusive is back on PlayStation's own pages; why now: spotted today; players here: it shows on the UAE pages; payoff: Sony has not said what it means
reel_check.ANGLE type items (report): yes: finding = badge on two pages, evidence = the pages, consequence = none stated by Sony, limits = no Sony statement, Push Square's 'doubling down' and PC-sales claims not used
reel_check.STORY one paragraph: yes: the badge appears on Ghost of Yotei, then on Until Dawn 2; a user spotted it, per Push Square
reel_check.STORY subject before pronoun: yes: headline names the badge and the game; no pronoun-first line
reel_check.STORY release verbs: n/a: no release date or verb in the lines
reel_check.STORY names: yes: Sony (Sony) and بوش سكوير (Push Square) with Latin at first mention; game names in English as written by the publisher
reel_check.WRITING headline: yes: news word شارة and the game in the first five words
reel_check.WRITING lines: yes: three lines read aloud, each on its picture
reel_check.WRITING caption: yes: caption names the game by the second sentence, ends #ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب then two tags
reel_check.WRITING X text: yes: short, attributes the sighting to Push Square, no hashtags
reel_check.WRITING urgency: yes: chip تقرير (a user sighting reported by an outlet, confirmed on the pages); not عاجل
reel_check.WRITING tone: yes: neutral, no claim about Sony's intent
reel_check.SOUND own sound: yes: stills have no sound of their own; our bed neon_c, reason: stills Reel
reel_check.SOUND our effects: yes: none over footage; no kit blips
reel_check.PICTURE footage first: n/a: stills_reason no_footage; the page videos are 5 and 10 s dark loops, trailers not reachable
reel_check.PICTURE shows the game: yes: Ghost of Yotei key art, both pages, Until Dawn 2 key art
reel_check.PICTURE not the same as last 5 Reels: yes: picture: PlayStation.com page captures, new to the feed
reel_check.PICTURE crop judged: yes: crops are vertical captures at 2x, enlargement 1.26x at most, nothing cut
reel_check.PICTURE headline in band: yes: headline over the art, face-free band
reel_check.PICTURE credit: yes: credits cover all four shots

note: pace_ok: each page capture carries the evidence and its line needs 4.3 to 4.7 s of reading time, so the picture holds 4.6 to 5.0 s with the push-in and the line entering on the cut; a cut every 4 s would make the lines unreadable. Report Reel: the evidence is the live pages. Source kind: our own 2x captures of playstation.com (UAE) at 16:30 to 16:40Z. Audio: our bed (stills). sensitive: none. picture: PlayStation.com page captures, new to the feed. The 'doubling down' and PC sales lines of Push Square are opinion and are not used.
